name: Devin on label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  devin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.label.name == 'devin' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Read issue data
        id: issue
        run: |
          title=$(jq -r '.issue.title' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          url=$(jq -r '.issue.html_url' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          body=$(jq -r '.issue.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          echo "title=$title" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "url=$url" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "body<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$body" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Devin session
        id: devin
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@main
        with:
          prompt-text: |
            Issue Title: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
            Issue URL: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.url }}
            Issue Body:
            ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Comment on issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          SESSION_URL: ${{ steps.devin.outputs.session-url }}
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = context.issue.number;
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              body: `Devin session created: ${sessionUrl}`
            });

            Issue Body:
